title: Software Engineering fundamentals matter more
summary: A thoughtful article arguing that traditional software engineering fundamentals—testing, architecture, debugging, and code quality—remain critical and perhaps even more important in the age of AI-assisted development. The piece counters the hype around AI coding tools by emphasizing that strong foundational skills are essential for effectively leveraging these new technologies.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that AI tools reduce the need for software engineering fundamentals.
why_valuable: Provides practical guidance on why mastering core engineering principles remains essential for building reliable, maintainable software regardless of emerging AI technologies.
